sqlquery.from:
(
with tasks as (select t.id,t.name ,pr.name priority,st.name status,st.code statusCode,t.projectid,t.dueDate-now() timeleft, coalesce(t.percent,0) pers , t.startdate startdate, t.duedate enddate ,t.dueDate ,p.name projectName from "$".task t join "$".reference pr on t.priorityid=pr.id join "$".reference st on t.statusid=st.id left join "$".project p on t.projectid=p.id where t.deleted is not true and t.isissue is not true)
select t.id, max(t.projectName) projectName, max(t.name) taskname, max(t.priority) priority, max(t.status) taskstatus ,max(pers) pers,max(t.startdate) stardate,max(t.enddate) enddate ,max(case isoverdue='Yes' when true then (case interval '-1 day' >= timeleft when true then to_char(timeleft,'(DD "d")') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24 "h" MI "m"') end ) else ( case timeleft>= interval '1 day' when true then to_char(timeleft,'DD "d"') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24"h" MI"m"') end ) end) timeleft , max(isOverdue) isOverdue from (select *, case interval '0'>t.dueDate-now() and statusCode not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CLOSED') when true then 'Yes' else 'No' end isOverdue from tasks t where statusCode in ('WAITING_FOR_SOMEONE_ELSE','NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') ) t join "$".taskrbac tr on t.id=tr.taskID join "$".taskpermission tp on (tr.taskPermissionId=tp.id and tp.view is true) join "$".trusteegroup tg on tr.groupid=tg.id join "$".myuser_trusteegroup mt on tg.id=mt.membershipgroups_id join (select u.id from "$".myuser u where u.id not in(select id from "$".clientcontact )) u on mt.myuser_id =u.id where u.id=#?user_id?# group by t.id union
select t.id, max(t.projectName) projectName, max(t.name) taskname, max(t.priority) priority, max(t.status) status,max(pers) pers,max(t.startdate) startdate,max(t.enddate) enddate ,max(case isoverdue='Yes' when true then (case interval '-1 day' >= timeleft when true then to_char(timeleft,'(DD "d")') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24 "h" MI "m"') end ) else ( case timeleft>= interval '1 day' when true then to_char(timeleft,'DD "d"') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24"h" MI"m"') end ) end) timeleft , max(isOverdue) isOverdue from (select t.* , case interval '0'>t.dueDate-now() and statusCode not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CLOSED') when true then 'Yes' else 'No' end isOverdue from tasks t join "$".employeetask et on et.taskid=t.id join "$".projectemployee pe on pe.id=et.projectEmployeeId join "$".teamEmployee te on te.id=pe.employeeDepartmentId where te.employeeid=#?user_id?# and statusCode in ('WAITING_FOR_SOMEONE_ELSE','NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') ) t group by t.id union
select t.id, max(t.projectName) projectName, max(t.name) taskname, max(t.priority) priority, max(t.status) status,max(pers) pers,max(t.startdate) startdate,max(t.enddate) enddate ,max(case isoverdue='Yes' when true then (case interval '-1 day' >= timeleft when true then to_char(timeleft,'(DD "d")') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24 "h" MI "m"') end ) else ( case timeleft>= interval '1 day' when true then to_char(timeleft,'DD "d"') else to_char(timeleft,'HH24"h" MI"m"') end ) end) timeleft , max(isOverdue) isOverdue from (select * , case interval '0'>t.dueDate-now() and statusCode not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CLOSED') when true then 'Yes' else 'No' end isOverdue from tasks t ) t join "$".project p on t.projectid=p.id join "$".crmAccount ca on p.clientid=ca.id join "$".crmcontact c on c.crmAccount=ca.id join "$".clientcontact cc on c.id=cc.crmcontactid join "$".myuser u on cc.id=u.id where u.id=#?user_id?# group by t.id
) t
